# Setup Specification
## Refinement Summary
- **Changed:** only new screener matches with a completed bullish engulfing daily candle are eligible.
- **Changed:** from eligible matches for the day, process only the one with the largest green candle body.
- All other fixed settings remain unchanged.

## Screener
- Name: Biggest Green Candle Finder (id `777a9e34`)
- Runtime parameters: universe=nifty_200
## Schedule & run window
- Runs every Daily (after close) candle close until Pause / Stop; no intraday time gate.
## Universe & scope
- Universe: screener's own (NIFTY 200)
- Scope: All new matches
## Duplicate policy
- Policy: Alert once per stock per day
## Alerts
- Channel: In-app
- Message template: New stock alert: {stock} at {time} on {date} - {screener}.
## Trade legs
- Direction: taken from the screener's direction column (BUY = long, SELL = short, NEUTRAL = no trade)
- Entry: Market
- Stop-loss: 1.0x signal candle range; no profit target
- Holding period: Multi-day, maximum 60 trading days
- Capital: Rs 1,000,000; default cap per position: Rs 25,000; max 3 open positions
- Product: CNC
## Guardrails
- Max trades per day: 10
- Cooldown per stock: 30 minutes
## Custom instructions (verbatim)
1. FIRST CHECK SHOULD BE BULLISH ENGULFING CANDLE PATTERN, OUT OF ALL BULLISH ENGULFING FOUND FOR THE DAY , THE BIGGEST ONE WILL BE PICKED

## Baseline (fixed for every setup)
- **Schedule:** the engine evaluates at every completed screener candle close until Pause / Stop.
- **Direction:** taken from the screener's `direction` column; the setup never decides BUY / SELL itself.
- **Capital per execution:** read from `setup.sizing.per_position_cap` at runtime.
- **Holding period:** read from `setup.spec.holding_period` at runtime.
